messages:
Aisha Patel: FYI running into auth rotation + embed pipeline issue in the new Vite+Next starter. Lots of 401s when multiple requests trigger token refresh. Repro steps below.

Dom Lee: Ugh. Are you using SDK v0.9.2? We had a token refresh race fix in 0.9.3.

Aisha Patel: Nope pinned at 0.9.2 for sample app stability. Repro:
1) start the sample (vite+next) with the embed pipeline
2) fire 10 concurrent embed requests (simple load test)
3) rotate API key (simulate short-lived creds)
Result: ~40% 401s and the embed queue stalls for a few seconds.

Kelly Ortiz: Can you paste a small excerpt of the logs? Also which rotation method — KMS-based key swap or session-level refresh?

Aisha Patel: Using local short-lived REDWOOD_API_KEY rotation script (to simulate customer env). Logs show:
```
[2026-03-01T12:34:21Z] warn: token refresh started for key tmp_abc123
[2026-03-01T12:34:21Z] error: embed request id=5 401 Unauthorized
[2026-03-01T12:34:21Z] error: embed request id=7 401 Unauthorized
```
Looks like each request tries to refresh independently instead of coordinating.

Samir Rao: This matches a known race where the JS SDK invoked token refresh per request instead of using a singleflight. We merged a fix at https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/412 but haven't published a patch release yet.

Aisha Patel: Is there a quick patch we can vendor into the starter until the release? We need something minimal so customers following the sample don't hit this.

Samir Rao: Yes — quick workaround in the auth adapter: use a global refresh promise as a lock. Example:
```js
let refreshPromise = null;
async function ensureToken(){
  if (refreshPromise) return refreshPromise;
  refreshPromise = fetchNewToken().finally(() => { refreshPromise = null; });
  return refreshPromise;
}
// call ensureToken() before making embed requests
```
Also crank SDK client retries to 3 with exponential backoff while you vendor this. `client.config.retries = 3`

Dom Lee: Also, for the starter app you can disable automatic batching during rotation to avoid head-of-line blocking: `BATCHING_ENABLED=false` in env for the local run. That makes error patterns clearer and avoids queue stalls.

deploy-bot: roll triggered: backport PR #412 -> preview build at https://ci.redwood/preview/2187 :white_check_mark:

Aisha Patel: Thanks — will patch starter with the lock + note about pinning SDK until release. I'll re-run the load test and report results. If it fixes I'll open a tiny PR to the samples repo.

Kelly Ortiz: Can someone add an e2e test to devex-evals for concurrent rotations? This would catch regressions.

Samir Rao: Yep I can add a test next week, adding to my board.
